verses.en: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
verses.sm: UA tuua e ia lea mea, ona maliu atu lea i lona lava nuu; ua mulimuli atu foi ona soo ia te ia.

verses.en: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
verses.sm: Ua oo i le sapati, ona a‘oa‘o atu lea e ia i le sunako, e toatele o e na faalogo ai, ua ofo i latou, ua faapea atu, Maifea na maua ai e lenei tagata ia mea ? se a foi lenei poto ua tuuina atu ia te ia, ina ua faia e ona lima vavega e faapena ona tele ?

verses.en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
verses.sm: E le o le tufuga ea lenei, le tama a Maria, o lona uso foi o Iakopo, ma Lose, ma Iuta, ma Simona? e le o iinei foi ea ia te i tatou oua tuafāfine ? Ona latou tausuai ai lea ia te ia.

verses.en: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou, E leai se perofeta e le mamalu, ua na o lona lava nuu, ma lona aiga, ma lona fale e le mamalu ai.

verses.en: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
verses.sm: Ona le mafaia lea e ia ona fai o se vavega i lea mea, na o nai tagata mamai e toaitiiti ua ia faaee ai ona lima, ma faamaloloina.

verses.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
verses.sm: Ua ofo foi o ia i lo latou le faatuatua; ona faataamilo lea o ia i faoa aai, ma a‘oa‘0 atu.

verses.en: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
verses.sm: Ua valaau atu ia i le toatinoagafulu ma le toalua, ona aau atu lea ia te i latou e taitoalua, ua ia tuu atu foi ia te i latou le pule i agaga leaga ;

verses.en: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
verses.sm: ma na fetalai atu ia te i latou, aua latou te ave se mea i a latou malaga, tau lava o le tootoo e tasi; aua se taga, aua ni mea e ‘ai, ia leai foi ni tupe i o latou fusi,

verses.en: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
verses.sm: a ia faaseevaeina o latou vae; aua foi le tailua o ofu e ofu ai.

verses.en: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, O se mea tou te ulu atu ai i se fale, ia outou nonofo ai i le tou o ai.

verses.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.sm: Ai se le talia outou, pe le faalogo ia te outou, a outou o ese i lea mea, i le tou tūtū atu ai le eleele nai o outou vae, e fai ma molimau ia te i latou ; e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e feoloolo Sotoma ma Komoro i le aso faamasino, i lea lava aai.

verses.en: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
verses.sm: Ona latou o atu ai lea ma tala‘i atu ina ia latou salamo.

verses.en: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
verses.sm: E toatele foi temoni ua latou tulia, e toatele foi o e na mamai ua latou faauuina i le suāuu, ma faamaloloina.

verses.en: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai le tupu o Herota, (auā ua ta‘ua lona suafa,) ona fai ane lea o ia, Ua tulai Ioane le papatiso nai e ua oti, o le mea lea ua fai ai e ia o vavega.

verses.en: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
verses.sm: Ua fai ane isi, O Elia lena; a o isi, ua faapea ane, O le perofeta ia, pe faapei o se tasi o le au perofeta.

verses.en: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
verses.sm: A ua faalogo ai Herota, ona fai ane lea, O Ioane lena sa ou vavaeeseina lona ulu; ua toe tulai ia nai e ua oti.

verses.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
verses.sm: Auā sa aauina nisi e Herota e pue ia Ioane, ma noanoa ia te ia i le fale puipui, ona o Herotia le avā a Filipo lona uso, ina ua fai o ia māna avā.

verses.en: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
verses.sm: Auā sa fai atu Ioane ia Herota, E sa ona e fai avā i le avā a lou uso.

verses.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
verses.sm: O lea na ita ai Herotia ia te ia, na ia fia fasioti foi ia te ia, a ua le mafai;

verses.en: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
verses.sm: auā sa mata4u Herota ia Ioane, ina ua iloa o le tagata amiotonu o ia, ma le paia; sa leoleo foi o ia ia te ia, na faalogo foi ia te ia, ma na faia mea e tele, ma faalogo ia te ia ma le fiafia.

verses.en: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
verses.sm: Ua oo i le aso e paganoa, o le aso lea e fai ai le faamanatuga o le fanau mai o Herota, na fai ai e ia le talisuaga tele i alii sili, ma alii o ‘au e taitoaafe, ma matai sili o Kalilaia.

verses.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
verses.sm: Ua ulufale foi le tama teine a Herotia ua saa, ua faafiafia ai ia Herota, atoa ma i latou sa taooto e aai faatasi ma la; ona fai atu ai lea o le tupu i le teine, “Ia e fai mai ia te au se mea e te manao i ai, Ou te avatu lava ia te oe.”

verses.en: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
verses.sm: ua faafiafia ai ia Herota, atoa ma i latou sa taooto e aai faatasi ma ia; ona fai atu ai lea o le tupu i le teine, Ia e fai mai ia te au se mea e te manao i ai, ou te avatu lava ia te mea e te fai mai ai, ou te avatua lava ia te oe, e oo lava i le vaeluagalemu o lo‘u malo.

verses.en: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
verses.sm: Ona ulufafo lea o ia, ma fai atu i lona tinā, Se a se mea ou te fai atu i ai ? Ua fai mai o ia, O le ulu o Ioane le papatiso.

verses.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
verses.sm: Ona ulufale loa lea o ia i le tupu, ua tele lise, ua fai atu ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Ou te manao ina ia e au mai nei lava le ulu o Ioane le papatiso i se tanoa.

verses.en: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
verses.sm: Ona tiga tele ai lea o le tupu; a ona o lana augani, ma e ua taooto e aai faatasi ma ia, ua ia le mafai ona faafiti atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.sm: A ua auina loa e le tupu le tasi o le 4au e faafeao, ua fai atu ia aumaia lona ulu. Ona alu ai lea o ia, ma vavaeeseina lona ulu i le fale puipui.

verses.en: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
verses.sm: Ua ia au mai foi lona ulu i le tanoa, ua avane i le teine; ua avatu foi e le teine i lona tinā.

verses.en: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai ona soo, ona o ane lea o i latou, ma ave lona tino, ma tuu ai i le tuugamau.

verses.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
verses.sm: Ua potopoto mai le au aposetolo ia Iesu, ua latou talatala mai foi ia te ia i mea uma, o mea na latou faia, atoa ma mea na latou a‘oa‘oina.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, Ina o mai ia, tau lava o i tatou, i se mea tuufua, se‘i tou mapu ae teisi; auā e toatele e na feoai ai, ua le mafai ai i latou ona aai.

verses.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
verses.sm: Ona latou o atu ai lea ua na o i latou i le vaa i le mea tuufua.

verses.en: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
verses.sm: A ua vaai atu le motu o tagata ina na latou o, e toatele foi ua iloa o ia; ona latou taufetuli atu ai lea mai aai uma, ua ui a uta, ua muamua ia te i latou ; ua tolo‘a‘i mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.sm: Ua maliu atu Iesu, ua na silafia le motu o tagata e toatele, ona mutimuti vale ai lea o lona alofa ia te i latou, auā ua faapei o mamoe i latou e leai so latou leoleo ; ona a‘oa‘o atu- lea o ia ia te i latou i mea e tele.

verses.en: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
verses.sm: Ua levaleva le aso, ona o mai ai lea o ona soo ia te ia, ua faapea mai, O le mea tmifua lenei, ua levaleva foi le aso ;

verses.en: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
verses.sm: ina e tuuina atu i latou ina ia latou o atu i faoa aai ma aai ua latalata mai, ma faatau ai ni a latou mea e ‘ai; auā ua leai sa latou mea e aai ai.

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
verses.sm: A ua tali atu ia ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, Ina avatu ia e outou ni mea e ‘ai mā latou. Ona o ea e faatau ni mea e ‘ai e tusa ma tenari e lua selau, ma avatu ai ia te i latou e aai ai ?

verses.en: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, Pe fia a outou areto ? ina o ia se‘i iloilo. Ua latou iloa, ona fai mai ai lea, E lima, ma ra e lua lau.

verses.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, ia latou fai atu i tagata uma, ia taooto i latou i vasega i le mutia.

w.en: he his and preached one another

verses.en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
verses.sm: Ona taooto ai lea o i latou i vasega, e taitoaselau, ma tai- •toalimagafulu.

verses.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
verses.sm: Ua tago o ia i areto e lima ma i‘a e lua lau, ona tepa ae lea i le lagi, na faafetai; ona tofitofi lea i areto, ma avatu i ona soo, latou te laulau atn ai ia te i latou ; ma i‘a foi e lua lau ua na tufatufa atu ai ia te i latou uma.

verses.en: And they did all eat, and were filled.
verses.sm: Ona aai uma lea o i latou,

verses.en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
verses.sm: ua maoona. Ua latou fue foi i ato e sefulu ma le lua, ua tutumu i toe mea, atoa ma fāsi i‘a.

verses.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
verses.sm: O i latou na aai i areto, pe limagaafe o tane.

verses.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
verses.sm: Ona iranai loa lea o ia i ona soo ina ia latou o ae i le vaa, ma muamua atu i le tasi itu i Petesaita, ina seia tuuina atu e ia le motu o tagata ia 5.'

verses.en: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
verses.sm: Ua faamāvae o ia ia te i latou, ona maliu atu lea o ia i le mauga e tatalo.

verses.en: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le afiafi, ua i totonu o le vasa le vaa; a ua toatasi o ia i uta.

verses.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
verses.sm: Ua silafia e ia i latou ua tigaina i taualo, auā ua agi mai i luma le matagi; ona maliu atu lea o ia ia te i latou i le leoleoga e fa o le po, ua savali i luga o le vai, o le a maliu loa.

verses.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
verses.sm: A o i latou ua iloa o ia ua savali i luga o le vai, fa i latou se aitu ; ona latou uio ai lea.

verses.en: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
verses.sm: Auā ua iloa o ia e i latou uma, ua atuatuvale ai; ona fetalai atu loa lea o ia ia te i latou, ua faapea atu ia te i lat-ou, la outou loto tetele; o a‘u lenei, aua tou te matatau.

verses.en: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
verses.sm: Ona maliu ae lea o ia i luga o le vaa ia te i latou, ona malū . ai lea o le matagi; ona matuā segia ai lea o latou mauli,ua latou ofo ai.

verses.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
verses.sm: Auā ua le manatunatu i areto, ina ua maaa o latou loto.

verses.en: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
verses.sm: Ua latou o atu i le tasi itu, ua oo i le nuu o Kenesareta, ua latou tūta atu i ai.

verses.en: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
verses.sm: Ua latou o atu nai le vaa, ona latou iloa loa lea o ia;

verses.en: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
verses.sm: ona taufetuli mai ai lea o i latou i lena itu uma, o mea uma na faalogo i ai. latou o i ai ua mamai.

verses.en: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
verses.sm: O mea uma foi ua ia maliu atu i ai, po o faoa aai, po o aai tetele, po o aai, ua latou tuu ai e mamai i malae, ma aioi mai ia te ia, ina ia latou papai atu tau lava o le tuupao o lona ofu ; o e na papai ia te ia, na malolo ai i latou uma. O le mea e leaya ai tagata; o le
